coordinateSystem: label, tapArea and path in % of image width/height from top-left; layers are full-size transparent overlays aligned to the base
source: Natural Earth 1:50m land and countries, 1:10m ocean polygons; Europe polygon from render.py

rules.continents: 7 continents; Europe/Asia border = Ural Mts, Ural R., Caspian, Kuma-Manych (same as the approved Europe map); Sinai in Asia; Greenland in North America; Oceania islands and New Zealand are not part of a continent
rules.newGuinea: not part of a continent (decided 2026-10-23): a tap there counts for no continent
rules.oceans: 5 oceans; seas belong to the ocean they open into; south of 60S = Southern Ocean (IHO 2000); Mediterranean and Black Sea count as Atlantic; the Caspian is not part of an ocean; Hudson Bay, James Bay, the Norwegian Sea and Baffin Bay count for no ocean (sources differ: Atlantic or Arctic; Norwegian Sea and Baffin Bay decided by Svetlana 2026-10-24)
rules.touch: tapArea is geographic geometry only: the app adds screen-space tolerance (>= 44 CSS px); a tap on a small island near a continent counts for that continent
rules.holes: an ocean tapArea has "holes": islands cut out of it. A point counts for the ocean when it is inside one of the tapArea polygons and inside none of its holes, so a tap on Japan, Madagascar or New Zealand never counts as an ocean

reveal: continent layers are watercolour tints: show a continent layer once it is learned, so the map is fully coloured at the end of the section
